title: Compute eigenenergies
action: For Bi2Se3, using the continuum-model Hamiltonian with hard-wall boundary conditions and the material parameters m0=-0.169 eV, m1=3.353 eV Å², m2=29.375 eV Å², A=2.513 eV Å, B=1.836 eV Å, solve the cylindrical TI secular equation at zero axial momentum (kz=0) for the lowest positive-energy surface states. Do this for total angular momentum projections j = 0.5 and 1.5, and for cylinder radii R = 2*R0, 4*R0, 6*R0, 8*R0, 10*R0 where R0 = 1.49 nm. Output the eigenenergies.
description: Positive-energy surface state eigenenergies for different j and R at kz=0.

title: Compute overlap integrals for optical absorption
action: Using the eigenfunctions obtained from the secular equation for the s=-, j=-0.5 state and the s=+, j=+0.5 state, compute the radial overlap integrals S14 and S23 (defined as integrals of products of radial components) between these two states. Evaluate for each radius R in the same set as step_01. Output the overlap integrals.
description: Overlap integrals S14 and S23 for the absorption threshold transition between s=-, j=-0.5 and s=+, j=+0.5.
output_schema: Columns: j (half-integer, set to 0.5 for this transition), R (nm), S_14 (dimensionless), S_23 (dimensionless).
